text:
CATHEDRAL IN FREEFALL

[Intro]
One bell for the living.
One for the recorded.

[Verse 1]
Six hundred voices under glass
One name I know by heart
The storage lights blink blue and green
Like windows after dark

Your last goodbye is pitched too high
A small bright ghost of sound
I reach to slow the playback down
The warning bell comes round

[Pre-Chorus]
The engines shudder underfoot
The stars slide out of frame
The console asks what I will save
And offers me your name

[Chorus]
Cathedral in freefall
The bells are breaking time
Your voice comes through in fragments
Still landing next to mine

One hand on the archive
One hand upon the door
Cathedral in freefall
I can't hold both anymore

[Post-Chorus]
Falling, falling
Out of time
Falling, falling
Still in line

[Verse 2]
The painted saints begin to peel
A loose screw leaves the floor
The gravity lights turn to red
The bell tolls seven more

Your voice keeps skipping on the word
I never let you say
I used to call that little loop
A reason I should stay

[Pre-Chorus 2]
The door won't wait for perfect words
The countdown doesn't care
I thought I kept you safe in here
But only kept you there

[Chorus]
Cathedral in freefall
The bells are breaking time
Your voice comes through in fragments
Still landing next to mine

One hand on the archive
One hand upon the door
Cathedral in freefall
I can't hold both anymore

[Instrumental Duel]

[Freefall Breakdown]
No up.
No down.
Just the sound.

[Bridge]
I know the click before your laugh
The breath before goodbye
I counted every little sound
To keep the years in line

The exit light is flashing now
I take my hand away
The speakers fade; the bell remains
One note I cannot save

[Final Chorus]
Cathedral in freefall
The bells are breaking time
Your voice dissolves to static
I sing the missing line

I leave the archive turning
I pull the handle down
Cathedral in freefall
I take the song, not the sound

[Final Hook]
Let it fall
Let it fall
The last bell
Through it all

[Outro]
Out here, I can hear myself breathe.
